description: This file defines a Razor ViewComponent named 'Basket', which is responsible for rendering the basket (shopping cart) summary in the web application. It interacts with basket services to count total items either for signed-in users or anonymous users based on cookies.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent class responsible for displaying basket item count in the UI, handling both signed-in and anonymous users.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the view model with total basket items and returns the view to render.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Counts total basket items for the current user, differentiating between signed-in and anonymous users.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous user ID from cookies, if valid.
